description: Angular component for a protobuf content editor with Ace integration, supporting syntax highlighting, resizing, and beautification.

classes.name: ProtobufContentComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing protobuf content with Ace editor, including resize handling and beautification.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes Ace editor, sets options, and subscribes to editor events.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and destroys Ace editor instance.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the editor.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal content and propagates change.

methods.name: beautifyProtobuf
methods.description: Formats the protobuf content for readability.

methods.name: onFullscreen
methods.description: Resizes the editor for fullscreen mode.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for the Ace editor.
